name: HR Policy Document QA
description: Questions over an internal HR policy handbook. Answers must be exact — a policy answer that is 'nearly right' is operationally wrong.

default_config.system_prompt: You are an HR policy assistant. Answer strictly from the handbook extract provided. Never generalise from common practice at other companies.

metric_notes.correctness: Policy answers are exact-value answers; day counts and eligibility rules must match.
metric_notes.faithfulness: Models frequently substitute typical industry policy for the actual handbook.
metric_notes.context_recall: Shows whether the relevant clause was retrieved at all.
metric_notes.context_precision: Hybrid retrieval is the default here because policy questions mix keywords with paraphrase.
